_: What this repository's gate reads and builds. No census of the files its suite opens has been taken here, so `reads` claims every tracked file (`**`): nothing is gate-inert, the same conservative reading the repository had with no record. `builds` names what the gate (run.ps1: the solution build and suites, then the parity leg, which Fable-compiles tests/Fuaran.Program.Parity.Fable and runs it under node) builds, and `notBuilt` each project file it deliberately does not, with the reason. Checked: the coverage check classifies every tracked project file against the pair, and once `builds` is declared an unreached project is an error and refuses a landing.
